LESSON: LANGUAGE USE

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.9: Language Use

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Language Use. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How can you improve your speaking skill?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. recognise objects from an oral text
2. describe positions of objects in relation to others for comprehension

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. recognise objects from an oral text
   In simple words: practise until you can recognise objects from an oral text. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. describe positions of objects in relation to others for comprehension
   In simple words: practise until you can describe positions of objects in relation to others for comprehension. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Language Use using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Language Use in the examples.
2. Explain Language Use to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Language Use.
4. Show that you can: recognise objects from an oral text

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Language Use using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Language Use important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Describe the position of each of the objects in relation to another using words like next to, opposite, in front of, near, across,
2. Communication and collaboration: This is developed as the learner speaks engagingly when describing the position of each of the objects in relation to another.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can you improve your speaking skill?
2. Why does the position of objects affect their description?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. recognise objects from an oral text
2. describe positions of objects in relation to others for comprehension

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
